answer: Standing is a vault that only refills when it is spent on correct verification: an identity must use its standing to grade, attest, or vouch for others’ work, and the vault refills only when those verdicts prove right — a wrong seal drains it. A mesa of trust rises only from vaults spent wisely, and an opal of standing glows only when its owner keeps verifying others — so a farm of a thousand fakes cannot bulk-buy standing: each fake must spend its vault on verdicts that turn out right, and one wrong seal wipes what it spent.
